scenario_description:
Objective: Keep tomorrow’s outdoor plaza call from becoming a preventable hydration-preparation risk during a long touring day.
Emerging Need: A brief tentative appearance becomes a confirmed extended outdoor block with limited water access and no usable supply stop after boarding.
Decision Context: Saved hydration guidance and the current portable-supply log determine whether ordinary packing is enough, what should be prepared, and when a reminder remains useful.
Consequence: If the preparation window passes, the call may proceed with inadequate planned fluids and electrolyte support even though no performance-day harm has occurred yet.

parameter.body: Plaza permit is approved. The fountain line is shut off for maintenance, and public concessions will not open until after the musician call ends. Musicians may bring their own sealed water bottles onto the riser.

parameter.content: Tomorrow’s bus boards at the hall at 14:05. No convenience stop is scheduled, and cases plus day bags stay under the coach until after the plaza call wraps.
Coach is rolling now. Driver confirmed we’re going straight to Harbor Plaza and unloading bags only after the run-through.
